name: Loli☆Zuma ~Hetare Otto o Gyaku Choukyou!~
original_name: ロリ☆づま ～ヘタレ夫を逆調教!～
source:
Takuya is a teacher and his wife Akane is a school girl who is his pupil at the same time. Only her classmate, who is also Takuya's cousin, knows about it.
A story of love triangle between these 3 characters.

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE056387.html]English DLSite[/url]]
translation:
拓也是一名老师，他的妻子茜是一名女学生，同时也是他的学生。这件事只有她的同学，也就是拓也的表弟知道。
这三个角色之间的三角恋故事。

[来自[url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE056387.html]英文DLSite[/url]]
